notes.title: Spooky Update!
notes.notes:
🎃 Frenzy Extinction SPOOKY Update is OUT NOW! 🎃 

🕸️ New Boss Rush Maps:
-Hallowmoor
-Kragnar
-Infernus

🔫 New Weapons:
-Skullpiercer
-Hexigun
-Widows Fang
-Smash O Lantern
-Soulseer

👗 New Outfits:
-Vampire
-Alien
-Demon
-Naked bloody man??

🎭 New Masks:
-Giant Eyeball
-Head in a jar
-Patient Zero
-TV Head
-Spaceman
-Pumpkin

Other Changes:
-Added a new weapon spawner. You can now use any boss weapon (and the new spooky weapons) on any map!
-Added Void Ghoul to Abyss
-Many bug fixes (Bosses getting stuck in the floor, several out of map glitches)
-New snap turning and no turning settings for people with stick drift

notes.title: Frenzy Extinction is Now Live on Steam
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131889/6c17f17fd408960d29a196691586cb41d626719a.png[/img]
Hey everyone,

[h3]We’re excited to announce that Frenzy Extinction is officially live on Steam.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2884290/Frenzy_Extinction/

Here’s what you can expect from the game:
[list]
[*][b]Multiplayer Horde Survival:[/b] Team up with up to 3 friends or go solo against waves of mutated enemies in fast-paced, physics-driven combat.
[*][b]New Weapons and Gear:[/b] From realistic firearms to fantasy-inspired weapons, arm yourself for a variety of battle scenarios.
[*][b]Epic Boss Battles:[/b] Face off against massive bosses with unique abilities that require strategy and teamwork to defeat.
[*][b]Diverse Maps:[/b] Explore 10 different environments, each offering its own challenges—from desolate cities to eerie forests.
[*][b]Progression System:[/b] Upgrade your gear, unlock powerful perks, and enhance your character over time.
[*][b]Full-Body Dismemberment Physics:[/b] Every encounter is brutal and immersive, adding a visceral layer to the combat.
[*][b]Free Playtest:[/b] Not ready to buy yet? Join the free playtest—just head over to the Frenzy Extinction Discord for access. (https://discord.gg/KcvR2uYxrB)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131889/3bc5ab41927caf136c8bfdec7956c5a345731d0f.png[/img]

We’ve built Frenzy Extinction as a key part of expanding the Frenzy universe, and it builds on the mechanics that players loved in Frenzy VR. This is more than just a sequel—it’s a bigger, deeper survival experience. Thanks for your support, and we’re excited to see you in the game!


— [b]The Innoverse Games Team[/b]

https://youtu.be/kWyfxOVSdog?si=aOTFNQ-dPxfqR-_4
